subject: Fix overflow calculation for next timer event (#12474)
reason: The fix casts a timer callback's returned period to monotime before multiplying by 1000 in processTimeEvents (ae.c), preventing 32-bit overflow when the returned period exceeds ~2,147,483 ms (~35.8 minutes). The only aeTimeProc that can return such a value is moduleTimerHandler, when a loaded module has created timers via RedisModule_CreateTimer more than ~35.8 minutes apart; serverCron returns at most 1000 ms (hz >= 1), evictionTimeProc returns 0 or AE_NOMORE, and valkey-benchmark's showThroughput returns a fixed 250 ms, so no non-module path can overflow and behaviour is bit-identical on bot
